purpose: Common town materials for map-concept review; no map or narrative decision is made here.

assets.name: 읍성 성문 · 석축과 문루
assets.materialNotes: Cool irregular granite masses, three-bay timber pavilion, muted green bracket band, restrained broad paljak roof.
assets.placementNotes: Split stone contacts sit on a common support. The arch is empty artwork, not a cut through terrain. A future map must author separate collision solids and retain passage clearance.

assets.name: 관아 담장 · 열린 문간
assets.materialNotes: Long warm plaster planes over short granite courses; low tiled coping and a higher timber entry distinguish this from a fortress.
assets.placementNotes: Wall wings and post shoes contact y=0; threshold remains clear. An eave silhouette does not block arrows until corresponding collision is explicitly authored. No office name or insignia is assigned.

assets.name: 관창 외벽 · 열린 하역칸
assets.materialNotes: Low wide roof, timber-clad clay wall, closed plank store door, high vent and an open cargo bay on raised stone piers.
assets.placementNotes: Five stone piers touch ground; loading deck is at y=-152. The opening is at deck height, not ground. No implied ramp, walkable deck, river, cargo record or destructible gate is added.
